ui.head: Ask this chart
ui.lead: Ask anything you'd like about this chart. Answers come from the chart itself and describe tendencies, not conclusions.
ui.ph: For example: What kind of work suits me? (200 characters max)
ui.locked: Get a Pass or membership to ask this chart directly:
ui.signIn: Already have a Pass or membership? Sign in
ui.covered: Pass / membership: ask as many questions as you like
ui.cast: Want to see where this matter is heading and when? Cast a hexagram for it →
ui.err: That question didn't go through. Please try again.
ui.capHit: That's all for today. Come back tomorrow.
ui.tooShort: Say a little more, at least four characters.
ui.disclaimer: Answers describe tendencies in the chart and don't draw conclusions for you. They don't cover health, investing or legal matters.
